A yellow flag means the flagman has called

yellow flag, they know they must slow down
to line up and drive cautiously around the
track until the track has been cleared.

something that I couldn't pass up on.
First sponsor you ever got: Bad Dog Stump Grinding
Last driver you texted: Kyle Raddant
What current driver would make a good president of the United
States:Brian Wullen
Favorite Tv Show: Outdoors Channel
What sports did you play in high school: No time for
sports, work always got in the way.
Favorite fast food restaurant: Arby's
One thing you'd like to see changed in local dirt racing:Having
more practices for rookies.
Name a Shawano driver that retired too soon and wish would get
back behind the wheel: Pete Parker
If you could race for a living, what would you want to race...
NASCAR, USMTS, Sprint Car, or Dirt Late Model and why: Dirt
Late Model because it has been a dream of mine since I was a little kid to race a Late Model.

Dedication
Do you have any pre-race rituals that you perform before getting strapped in for a race: Point up to the sky in remembrance for
the important individuals in my life that can't physically be here with me, but are watching from above.
Tell the fans something they may not know about you: I can't sit still.
